elements.html: The Delray Beach Tennis Center was honored to host the 2026 Racquet Rally Invitational — a special two-day tennis & pickleball event featuring 10 of the top tennis players with autism in the United States.
elements.textContent: The Delray Beach Tennis Center was honored to host the 2026 Racquet Rally Invitational — a special two-day tennis & pickleball event featuring 10 of the top tennis players with autism in the United States.

elements.html: It was an incredible weekend filled with competition, camaraderie, and fun, led by former WTA professional Brenda Schultz-McCarthy, Love Serving Autism founder Lisa Pugliese-LaCroix, and a dedicated team of certified tennis professionals.
